title: Senior Software Engineer, Ecosystem Events
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Canada

Overview

As a software engineer on GitHub’s Ecosystem Events team, you will build and operate the webhooks platform that powers third-party integrations and many of GitHub’s flagship products. You will work with a distributed team of engineers on the event-driven systems developers use to integrate with GitHub. 

 

In this role, you will design, implement, ship, and support improvements to our webhook services and APIs. You will improve how the platform handles growing traffic, investigate delivery problems, and make our services easier to operate. Our tech stack is primarily Go and Ruby. We work closely with the teams responsible for databases, queues, networking, and compute infrastructure to deliver webhooks reliably at scale. 

 

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving distributed systems problems and care about the developers who depend on our events and integrations. Our team works remotely and relies on clear written communication and asynchronous collaboration. 


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and ship improvements to GitHub’s webhook services and APIs. 
  • Build and maintain event-driven systems that handle high volumes of traffic reliably. 
  • Debug problems across service boundaries and improve the tooling and observability needed to investigate them. 
  • Work with infrastructure partners to improve platform performance and resolve dependencies. 
  • Support teams across GitHub as they build webhook integrations. 
  • Provide technical leadership and help other engineers grow through mentoring, pairing, and code reviews. 
  • Maintain service health and respond to production problems through on-call and first responder rotations. 
  • Write architecture proposals and use experiments and prototypes to evaluate approaches to scaling our systems. 
  • Write maintainable code, test it, and use CI/CD pipelines to deliver changes safely. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

 

  • 6+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python 
    • OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python 
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python 
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python 
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field 
    • OR equivalent experience. 
  • 2+ years experience maintaining highly available, high-volume platforms. 
  • 2+ years experience building and maintaining event-driven systems. 

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years experience in one or more scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python, or a similar language) 
  • Minimum 2 years experience using general purpose programming languages (e.g., Go, Ruby, or a similar language). 
  • Minimum 3 years experience with cloud environments and/or Cloud Native Compute Foundation (CNCF) concepts. 
  • Experience with queuing or streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ. 
  • Experience with relational or distributed databases. 
  • Experience working on distributed teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills. 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the role

0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers.

Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes:

  • Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet

  • Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes

  • Kubernetes clusters and managed databases

  • A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps

All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs.

What you'll own

You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill.

  • Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses.

  • Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity.

  • Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades.

  • Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap.

  • Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps.

  • Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems.

  • Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet.

  • Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning.

  • Developer enablement: templates, preview environments, documentation and support for the engineers who ship on the platform.

Our stack

Kubernetes: GKE, EKS, Helm, Ingress and Gateway API, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies

Networking: TCP/IP, subnets and CIDR, routing, NAT, L4 and L7 load balancers, DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPC peering

Google Cloud: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, billing export to BigQuery

Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi

CI/CD and containers: Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Argo CD, Docker and BuildKit, container registries

Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, Alibaba CloudMonitor

Linux: Systems administration, systemd, disks and filesystems, performance debugging

Alibaba Cloud: ECS, VPC, NLB and ALB, ESSD disks, RDS, PolarDB, SAE, Cloud Firewall

AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, ALB and NLB, Route 53, S3, Organizations

Cloudflare: DNS, Workers, Tunnels, WAF and rate limiting, Zero Trust

Databases (operations): PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, managed Kafka

Blockchain nodes: CometBFT-based chains, reth and other EVM clients, P2P networking

Vercel: Projects, builds, ISR, team access

Confidential computing: Intel TDX virtual machines on Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud

Must-haves

  • We want 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform roles, including 3+ years running production Kubernetes and owning CI/CD pipelines.

Kubernetes, in depth

  • Upgrading control planes and node pools with no downtime, and keeping clusters on supported versions.

  • Scheduling: requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, priority, and eviction under node pressure.

  • Autoscaling with the HPA, cluster autoscaler or Karpenter, plus Spot or preemptible node pools for non-critical work.

  • Networking inside the cluster: CNI, Services, Ingress or Gateway API, network policies, and DNS within the cluster.

  • Security: RBAC, Pod Security, workload identity, and secrets that never sit in plain environment variables.

  • Stateful workloads: StatefulSets, persistent volumes and CSI drivers, and backup and restore.

  • Packaging and delivery with Helm or Kustomize, ideally through GitOps with Argo CD or Flux.

  • Debugging a failing pod, node or rollout from events, logs and metrics.

CI/CD, in depth

  • Pipeline design: you have built and run production CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Tekton). Pipelines are defined as code in a Jenkinsfile or workflow YAML, with shared libraries and reusable templates.

  • CI platform operations: running Jenkins controllers with ephemeral agents on Kubernetes, or self-hosted runners. That includes plugin and version upgrades, credential handling, and scaling build capacity.

  • Build pipelines: multi-service and monorepo builds with caching and parallel stages, and versioned artifacts. Container images built with Docker, BuildKit or Kaniko, including multi-architecture images, image scanning, SBOMs and signing.

  • Deployment pipelines: promotion from dev to staging to production with approvals and quality gates, plus blue-green, canary and fast rollback. GitOps with Argo CD or Flux, and database migrations as part of a release.

  • Infrastructure pipelines: Terraform or Pulumi plan and apply from CI, with policy checks and drift detection.

  • Pipeline security: short-lived credentials through OIDC federation or a secrets vault instead of long-lived keys, least-privilege deploy roles, and protected branches.

  • Release engineering for our chain: building and publishing node binaries and images, and coordinating rolling upgrades across validator and RPC fleets.

  • Delivery health: you track build time, build cost, flaky tests and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore), and you cut wasted builds with ignore rules and caching.

Networking fundamentals

  • TCP/IP, subnetting and CIDR, routing, NAT, and the difference between L4 and L7 load balancing.

  • DNS, TLS and certificates, firewalls and security groups.

  • Private connectivity: VPC design, peering, private endpoints, and keeping internal traffic off public IPs.

  • Troubleshooting with dig, curl, mtr and tcpdump, and understanding what internet egress costs.

Also required

  • Production experience on at least two of Google Cloud, AWS and Alibaba Cloud, and willingness to learn the third quickly.

  • Terraform or Pulumi in production, plus scripting in Bash and in Python or Go.

  • A track record of cutting a cloud bill with data, through rightsizing, cleanup or commitments.

  • A security-first habit with production credentials, and clear written communication.

Nice to have

  • Running blockchain nodes in production, such as CometBFT validators and sentries, EVM archive or RPC nodes, and snapshot pipelines.

  • Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and Zero Trust at scale.

  • Alibaba Cloud on the international site, including its billing and support model.

  • Confidential computing (Intel TDX) and GPU workloads.

  • CKA or CKS certification, a FinOps certification, or experience moving a team between CI systems, such as Jenkins to GitHub Actions.

  • Go or Rust, enough to read and patch the services you operate.

What we offer

In addition, 0G Labs is committed to the health and well being of all of our team members. To that end, we provide reimbursements towards a holistic set of experiences and courses:

  • Core self: Transcendental Meditation

  • Mind: Landmark Education

  • Emotion: Art of Communication

  • Body: Fitness, gym and exercise memberships/classes

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model.   • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

ElevenCreative brings together leading image and video models alongside our own audio models, so our users can make everything they need in one place. We are looking for someone to own our relationships with the model providers who make that possible, starting with video.

You will be the main point of contact for our model partners, help bring new models to ElevenCreative, and build partnerships that are good for our partners, our users, and our business. You will work closely with product, engineering, finance, marketing, and sales.

  • Can operate with US and European timezone overlap, with flexibility for partners in Asia.

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments where you define the playbook rather than follow one.

Bonus

  • Experience working with AI model or API providers.

  • Familiarity with usage-based or credit-based pricing.

  • Experience running co-marketing or channel partnerships.

Location

This role is remote. The team operates across US and European time zones, so the ability to maintain meaningful overlap with both is important.

Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours.

What You Will Do

Program Management — Oversee and manage our development and deployment processes, ensuring efficiency, effectiveness, and alignment with product timelines.

Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product, Science, Marketing/Coms teams, Design, and Solutions to ensure alignment of engineering operations with overall product and business objectives.

Project Delivery — Track project progress, timelines, and resources. Assist teams to implement processes to smoothen delivery process.

Process Improvement — Continuously identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and productivity of the engineering team, in coordination with the other TPMs.

Stakeholder Management — Regularly communicate with stakeholders to provide updates on program status, risks, and issues, and to manage expectations.

Risk Management — Identify potential risks and issues in the program lifecycle, and develop contingency plans to mitigate them.

What We're Looking For

• You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)
• You have proven experience in managing technical programs, preferably within an engineering team.
• You have a strong understanding of software lifecycle management and deployment processes
• You have excellent project management skills, with the ability to run multiple complex programs smoothly
• You are thriving in cross functional collaboration and you know how to adapt your communication to stakeholders
• You are highly organized and knows how to manage cross team dependencies
• You are a proactive problem-solver with a continuous improvement mindset.
• You have strong design thinking skills and feel comfortable with actively contributing to architecture decisions

Ideally, you have:

• Experience as a Software Developer.
• Already worked in an AI company/project.
• Knowledge of how LLMs are built and work.
• Already worked as a Technical Program Manager

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.
